001: Should we grab a drink after class?
Sounds great to me! Where do you feel like going?
We could go to that new bar they opened near the campus.
Oh, yeah! I've heard they have some amazing tapas.
Well, let's go, because today I need to unwind a bit.
Perfect, and you can tell me how your exam went.
002: Hey, have you seen Marta lately?
No, honestly, I haven't heard anything from her in weeks.
She's really swamped with her internship and barely has any free time.
That's a shame! We should organize a dinner to see her.
I think that's a good idea, so we can all catch up together.
Okay, I'll take care of texting her and finding a day that works for her.
003: Do you feel like coming to the concert on Friday with us?
What band is playing? I don't want to go in blind.
It's an indie band I discovered the other day, they play really well.
Hmm, I don't know them, but I trust your taste in music.
I'm sure you'll like them! Besides, the tickets weren't expensive.
Well then, count me in, because I don't want to miss it.
004: You won't believe what happened to me yesterday at the library.
Tell me, tell me, because you've got a look like you have a good story.
I fell asleep studying and the security guard had to wake me up.
No way! And weren't you super embarrassed?
So embarrassed! But thank goodness only he was there.
Haha, good thing no one else saw you, what a blush.
005: Should we meet up tomorrow to study together for the midterm?
Good idea, because by myself I can't concentrate at all.
We can go to the campus library, it's quiet.
Yeah, but we'd better get there early, because it fills up fast.
You're right, let's meet at nine thirty then.
Done, and that way we can take turns quizzing each other on the material.
006: Did you know Pablo is going on Erasmus next month?
Really? He hadn't told me anything, the date is coming up so fast.
Yeah, he's going to Dublin and he's really nervous about the language.
Well, we'll have to throw him a goodbye party before he leaves.
Of course, and we could give him something that reminds him of all of us.
I think that's a lovely touch, count me in for whatever.
007: Hey, can you lend me your notes from history class?
Sure, but I'm warning you, my handwriting is a bit so-so.
Don't worry, as long as it's understandable, it works for me.
I'll send them to you by email this afternoon, so you'll have them right away.
You're a lifesaver, I don't know what I'd do without you.
Oh, come on! That's what friends are for, right?
008: Have you seen that they put in a new outdoor terrace on campus?
Yeah, I saw it yesterday and it looks really nice for grabbing a drink.
We could go one day in the mid-afternoon, between classes.
Good idea! That way we take advantage of the nice weather before the cold arrives.
Well then, tomorrow if you feel like it, let's meet there at five.
Perfect, I'll bring something to snack on if you get the drinks.
009: Do you remember that time we got lost on the end-of-year trip?
Of course I remember! We were walking for two hours in the rain.
And in the end, it turned out the hotel was two streets away from where we started.
What a disaster! But now we look back on it and we crack up laughing.
Honestly, those are the moments you remember the most.
No doubt, the best stories always come from the biggest disasters.
010: Do you mind if I sit with you in the cafeteria?
Of course not! Come on, there's always room here.
It's just that my classmates all went out to eat today.
Well, even better, so you and I can chat for a bit, since we hadn't talked in days.
That's true, with the exams we haven't even had time to see each other.
Well, but there's less time left until we're done, and then we'll have the whole summer free.
